3634.title: Pi resume retains a deleted session directory
3634.rootCauseOneLine: BB allows the replacement cwd but resumes an unchanged Pi session whose header points to the deleted directory.
3634.proposedFix: Define durable provider session relocation or reject unsupported environment switches before commit.
3634.caveats: Real Pi resume reproduced twice; full environment-switch UI and model editing were not exercised. No simple fix: persisted-session handling or product policy decision required.
